description: Customs Ports of Entry is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Connected Communities Branch. Places where someone may lawfully enter Canada. This dataset contains the addresses and geographic locations of road, railway, air, and marine Canada Customs Ports of Entry in British Columbia. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Connected Communities Branch. Its tags are customs, economy. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2025-12-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
